frame: Rifle frame of assets/hk416: metres, +X shooter's left, +Y up, +Z to the muzzle, origin on the bore axis at the upper receiver's front face.

skeleton.note: Canonical LEFT hand, rest pose: X radial, Y distal, Z dorsal, origin at the wrist joint centre. The right hand is its mirror image (x -> -x). rest = 4x4 row-major, translation in metres.

angle_units: degrees, except the last four (pad_*): compression of a palm pad at its middle, millimetres

thenar.how: 50 % (SP) of 9.8 mm of muscle and skin between the glove and the first metacarpal (model geometry; bone half-thickness 6.0 mm I), plus 0.4 mm of glove (I); tapering to 1.8 mm over the trapezium (SP: 2.5 to 3.0 mm of tissue there)

hypothenar.how: 50 % (SP) of 13.4 mm between the glove and the fifth metacarpal (model geometry; bone half-thickness 4.5 mm I), plus 0.4 mm of glove (I)

midpalm.how: 50 % (SP) of 4.0 mm of skin, fat and aponeurosis over the flexor tendons (I), plus 0.4 mm of glove (I)

distal.how: 50 % (SP) of 5.0 mm of skin and fat pad in front of the metacarpal heads (I), plus 0.4 mm of glove (I)

idle.note: Both hands at rest on the rifle: firing hand with the trigger finger straight, support hand under the handguard.

finger_to_trigger.note: Trigger finger from straight along the receiver onto the trigger. No rifle clip.

finger_off_trigger.note: Trigger finger back to straight. No rifle clip.

trigger_pull.note: Starts and ends with the finger on the trigger (grip fire).

mag_release.note: The firing hand slides 9 mm forward on the grip, the trigger finger presses the magazine release, and the hand returns.

safety_to_fire.note: Firing thumb goes toward the selector lever on the left side as the lever turns. It does not reach it: the gap is measured in checks/contact.json and explained in notes/NOTES.md.

safety_to_safe.note: Firing thumb goes toward the selector lever on the left side as the lever turns. It does not reach it: the gap is measured in checks/contact.json and explained in notes/NOTES.md.

bolt_catch.note: Support hand comes back to the magazine well, its thumb presses the bolt catch paddle, and it returns to the handguard.

mag_out.note: Trigger finger holds the release; the support hand takes the magazine and draws it out. Ends holding the magazine below the rifle.

mag_in.note: Starts holding the magazine below the rifle (where mag_out ends); seats it and returns to the handguard.

charge.note: Support hand hooks the charging handle with the index finger, draws it back 75 mm, lets it fly forward and returns to the handguard.

dust_cover_open.note: The cover springs open by itself; the hands hold their grips.

rifle_proxy.note: Bounding boxes of a few parts of the locally built rifle and the motion of its moving parts in each clip, for drawing context in the sample page. Not a model of the rifle.
